zh-CN.title: 成长奖励正式进入资源库
items: 升级获得的气泡、背景和头像框会自动永久收进资源库

en.title: Growth rewards now live in your collection
items: Bubbles, backgrounds, and frames earned from leveling are now permanently added to your collection
Permanent VIP and its exclusive cosmetics now share one reliable ownership record
